description: Read-only Pipedrive CLI. Emits NDJSON on stdout for machine consumption.

output.applies_to: data commands only; --help and `pd manifest` are surface introspection and are exempt

pretty.note: Human table. No error object on stdout. An agent must never invoke pd with --pretty.

exit_codes.0: success, including a run bounded by --limit

global_flags.name: --pretty
global_flags.description: Human table on stdout. Unstable; do not parse.

global_flags.name: --no-cache
global_flags.description: Bypass the cached value and fetch fresh. The fresh response replaces the cached entry.

global_flags.name: --max-requests
global_flags.description: Hard ceiling. Aborts before it is exceeded. Cache hits do not count.

global_flags.name: --limit
global_flags.description: Stop after n records. Applied after validation and deduplication. Unset means every record.

global_flags.name: --resolve
global_flags.description: Add custom_fields_resolved, option labels and owner/relation names. Additive; raw fields unchanged.

global_flags.name: --resolve-budget
global_flags.description: Ceiling on extra requests spent on --resolve. Degrades to raw ids, never aborts.

global_flags.name: --help
global_flags.description: Print help for this command on stdout and exit 0.

commands.name: pipelines list
commands.summary: Every pipeline. Answered from cache when warm.

commands.name: pipelines get
commands.summary: One pipeline by id, filtered from the cached list.

commands.name: stages list
commands.summary: Every stage. Answered from cache when warm.

commands.name: stages get
commands.summary: One stage by id, filtered from the cached list.

commands.name: users list
commands.summary: Every user seat. Answered from cache when warm.

commands.name: users get
commands.summary: One user by id, filtered from the cached list. Issues no request on a warm cache.

commands.name: fields list
commands.summary: Field schemas for one entity, including custom field hashes and their display names.

flags.name: --entity
flags.description: Which entity's field schema to read.

commands.name: fields get
commands.summary: One field schema by field_code, filtered from the cached list.

flags.name: --entity
flags.description: Which entity the field belongs to.

other_commands.name: manifest
other_commands.summary: This document. One JSON object on stdout, not NDJSON.

other_commands.name: cache info
other_commands.summary: Cache path, entries present and their ages. Zero requests.

other_commands.name: cache clear
other_commands.summary: Delete the local cache subtree. Zero requests. Touches local files only, never Pipedrive.
